answer_1.quote: Diverse generative tasks: continual learning procedure is focused on generative tasks other than simple discriminative tasks like classification and with existence of vision information, task type is much more diverse with abundant scenarios
answer_1.outputs: The model generates responses to multimodal instructions, such as answering questions about images, providing bounding box coordinates, or answering OCR-based questions using single words or phrases.

answer_2.quote: We measure each dataset using metrics Last (performance after sequential training on all tasks, i.e., A T,i , i = 1, ...), Average, Backward Transfer (B), and Mean Accuracy (M).
